Home.caption: Issue 01 · agent bootstrap desk
Home.heroTitle: Raw idea in. Structured project pack out.
Home.heroSubtitle: BantuinCoding turns a messy project prompt into PRD, SRS, design contract, architecture, agent rules, skills, and a dependency-aware backlog for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other coding agents.
Home.noSlopDesc: Not a chatbot. Not an IDE. A disciplined documentation control room.
Home.proof1Copy: Provider keys stay session-scoped by default and never enter exported files.
Home.proof2Copy: Generate readable specs your coding agent can execute without extra context.
Home.proof3Copy: Download a controlled ZIP with predictable UTF-8 documentation paths.

Project.newTitle: Give the system a useful raw idea—not a perfect spec.
Project.newDesc: Drop an idea with rough boundaries. The analyzer will identify what is known, what is missing, and what requires confirmation.

NewProject.caption: Chapter 01 · capture intent
NewProject.title: Give the system a useful raw idea—not a perfect spec.
NewProject.subtitle: Describe the users, the core job, important features, and known constraints. Missing high-impact decisions become focused clarification questions later.
NewProject.projectIdeaPlaceholder: Who is this for? What must they be able to do? What business or technical constraints are already known?
NewProject.projectIdeaNote: Do not paste API keys or other secrets. This text becomes long-lived project context.
NewProject.refineNote: You can refine context before final generation.
NewProject.nextStep1: Analyze the raw idea and expose requirement gaps.
NewProject.nextStep2: Ask only the clarification questions that affect implementation.
NewProject.nextStep3: Normalize confirmed decisions into canonical project context.
NewProject.nextStep4: Plan and generate the right documentation depth.
NewProject.nextStep5: Resolve relevant skills and build a dependency-aware backlog.
NewProject.nextStep6: Review the Markdown and export a secret-safe ZIP.
NewProject.prerequisiteDesc: A valid provider session is required before AI analysis. You can create this draft now and configure the key separately.

ProviderDesk.caption: BYOK checkpoint
ProviderDesk.title: Wire the model without leaking the key.
ProviderDesk.subtitle: This screen only configures the current server session. Provider secrets do not belong in generated Markdown, browser-visible errors, fixtures, telemetry, or ZIP exports.
ProviderDesk.aiProviderDesc: Choose a provider, confirm the model ID, and test the connection before running analysis or document generation.
ProviderDesk.securityNoteDesc: Responses expose safe provider/model metadata only. If a provider rejects the key, the UI shows an actionable typed failure without printing the raw SDK payload.

Workspace.noBrief: No project brief has been recorded yet. Add the problem, intended users, and expected outcome before generation.
Workspace.docControlRoomDesc: A direct view of what the coding agent can rely on now, what still needs attention, and the next safe action.
Workspace.actionClarifyDesc: Provide required decisions to construct the canonical context.
Workspace.actionGenerateDesc: Plans documents, generates the pack, resolves skills, then builds the backlog.
Workspace.actionReviewDesc: The current documents can be inspected, edited, and packaged. Modified documents will not be overwritten by future regenerations.
Workspace.projectContextDesc: The canonical state holding all business boundaries and user instructions.
Workspace.unknownsDesc: Required decisions extracted from the idea that have been confirmed or safely assumed.
Workspace.clarificationRequiredDesc: The analyzer found high-impact unknowns. We cannot build an accurate spec without these boundaries.
Workspace.agentSkillsDesc: Known tools mapped to the project requirements. Add these to your agent's context or workflow before beginning execution.
Workspace.noSkills: No skills resolved for this project.
Workspace.exportDownloadDesc: Download the generated project documentation pack.
Workspace.zipSecurityDesc: The ZIP file strictly packages the *.md documents generated in this workspace. It does not contain any provider secrets or API keys from your session.
Workspace.agentPromptDesc: Copy this exact prompt and paste it to your coding agent (along with the unzipped files) to start autonomous execution.
Workspace.descEstablishContext: The project has no normalized context yet. Complete analysis and clarification so generators do not invent high-impact decisions.
Workspace.descGenerateFirst: The context exists, but no documents are ready. Generation will create the core artifacts, resolve skills, and assemble dependency-aware work.
Workspace.descResolveWarnings: {count} documents are failed or outdated. Review their status in Documents before packaging the project.
Workspace.descExportable: A previous export completed successfully. Review modified documents before downloading a fresh archive.
Workspace.descReviewPack: The current documents can be inspected, edited, and packaged. Modified documents remain eligible for export.
Workspace.readyExportable: Ready and modified files can export
Workspace.atLeastOneReq: At least one ready document is required
